description: Plugin-distributed hooks for memory-engineering. Auto-merged with the consumer's session hooks when the plugin is installed. Paths use ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} so they resolve to the plugin's install location.

hooks.comment: Advisory: review this memory-engineering deliverable against the §3 house opinions (a benchmark figure needs a source + retrieval date or an [unverified] mark; a cost / break-even claim needs a named baseline). Set MEMORY_ENGINEERING_STRICT=1 to make it blocking.
